lines.text: Three lines cross at one special point inside every triangle.
lines.caption: Three lines cross at one special point inside every triangle.

lines.text: That point hides a secret number. <short pause> Today we'll find out WHY it's there.
lines.caption: That point hides a secret number. Today we'll find out WHY it's there.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's crack it together.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's crack it together.

lines.text: Here's the question.
lines.caption: Here's the question.

lines.text: In triangle A B C, side B C is twenty-four.
lines.caption: In triangle A B C, side B C is twenty-four.

lines.text: The three medians meet at point G. A median joins a corner to the middle of the opposite side.
lines.caption: The three medians meet at point G. A median joins a corner to the middle of the opposite side.

lines.text: A segment through G runs parallel to B C. Its ends, E and F, sit on the other two sides.
lines.caption: A segment through G runs parallel to B C. Its ends, E and F, sit on the other two sides.

lines.text: How long is E F?
lines.caption: How long is E F?

lines.text: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.
lines.caption: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.

lines.text: So what do we really know?
lines.caption: So what do we really know?

lines.text: The bottom side is twenty-four. E F runs parallel to it, right through G.
lines.caption: The bottom side is twenty-four. E F runs parallel to it, right through G.

lines.text: So the real question is: how far down the triangle does G sit?
lines.caption: So the real question is: how far down the triangle does G sit?

lines.text: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Let's find where G sits. Call M the middle of B C, and L the middle of A C.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Let's find where G sits. Call M the middle of B C, and L the middle of A C.

lines.text: Now join M and L. This short segment has a superpower.
lines.caption: Now join M and L. This short segment has a superpower.

lines.text: Shrink the whole triangle toward corner C, to half size. A lands on L, and B lands on M.
lines.caption: Shrink the whole triangle toward corner C, to half size. A lands on L, and B lands on M.

lines.text: So M L is a half-size copy of A B. It's half as long, and it points the same way. It's parallel!
lines.caption: So M L is a half-size copy of A B. It's half as long, and it points the same way. It's parallel!

lines.text: Now look at the two medians, A M and B L. They cross at G and make a bowtie.
lines.caption: Now look at the two medians, A M and B L. They cross at G and make a bowtie.

lines.text: The big end of the bowtie is A B. The small end is M L.
lines.caption: The big end of the bowtie is A B. The small end is M L.

lines.text: A B and M L are parallel, so these two angles match. They make a Z shape.
lines.caption: A B and M L are parallel, so these two angles match. They make a Z shape.

lines.text: These two match as well. That's another Z, along the other median.
lines.caption: These two match as well. That's another Z, along the other median.

lines.text: M L is half of A B. So the small triangle G M L is a half-size copy of G A B.
lines.caption: M L is half of A B. So the small triangle G M L is a half-size copy of G A B.

lines.text: That means G M is half of A G. Two parts from A down to G, and one part from G to M.
lines.caption: That means G M is half of A G. Two parts from A down to G, and one part from G to M.

lines.text: So G is two thirds of the way down the median, starting from A!
lines.caption: So G is two thirds of the way down the median, starting from A!

lines.text: Now back to E F. It's parallel to B C, so triangle A E F is a shrunk copy of A B C.
lines.caption: Now back to E F. It's parallel to B C, so triangle A E F is a shrunk copy of A B C.

lines.text: How much smaller? Shrink A B C toward corner A, until B C lands on E F.
lines.caption: How much smaller? Shrink A B C toward corner A, until B C lands on E F.

lines.text: M slides up the median as it shrinks. It lands on E F, right at G.
lines.caption: M slides up the median as it shrinks. It lands on E F, right at G.

lines.text: G is two thirds of the way down. So every length shrinks to two thirds.
lines.caption: G is two thirds of the way down. So every length shrinks to two thirds.

lines.text: Two thirds of twenty-four is sixteen. <short pause> E F is sixteen! That's choice C.
lines.caption: Two thirds of twenty-four is sixteen. E F is sixteen! That's choice C.

lines.text: Here's a second way, using areas.
lines.caption: Here's a second way, using areas.

lines.text: First, a fact. A median cuts a triangle into two halves with equal area.
lines.caption: First, a fact. A median cuts a triangle into two halves with equal area.

lines.text: Why? The two bases are equal, and both halves have the same height.
lines.caption: Why? The two bases are equal, and both halves have the same height.

lines.text: The median A M splits triangle A B C in half. And G M splits triangle G B C in half.
lines.caption: The median A M splits triangle A B C in half. And G M splits triangle G B C in half.

lines.text: Take the small halves away from the big halves. So A B G and A C G have equal areas.
lines.caption: Take the small halves away from the big halves. So A B G and A C G have equal areas.

lines.text: Do the same with the median from B. Then A B G and B C G match too.
lines.caption: Do the same with the median from B. Then A B G and B C G match too.

lines.text: So G cuts the triangle into three pieces with equal area. Each one is a third.
lines.caption: So G cuts the triangle into three pieces with equal area. Each one is a third.

lines.text: Triangle G B C sits on B C, with a third of the area. So G is a third of the height up.
lines.caption: Triangle G B C sits on B C, with a third of the area. So G is a third of the height up.

lines.text: So from A down to E F is two thirds of the height. E F is two thirds of twenty-four. Sixteen again!
lines.caption: So from A down to E F is two thirds of the height. E F is two thirds of twenty-four. Sixteen again!

lines.text: When would you pick this way? When a problem talks about areas, or to double-check.
lines.caption: When would you pick this way? When a problem talks about areas, or to double-check.

lines.text: Now, let's look at the wrong answers. Each one puts G in the wrong spot.
lines.caption: Now, let's look at the wrong answers. Each one puts G in the wrong spot.

lines.text: Eight is what you'd get if you flipped it, and put G one third of the way down from A.
lines.caption: Eight is what you'd get if you flipped it, and put G one third of the way down from A.

lines.text: Twelve is the line through the middles of A B and A C. That's halfway down, not two thirds.
lines.caption: Twelve is the line through the middles of A B and A C. That's halfway down, not two thirds.

lines.text: Eighteen is what you'd get if G were three quarters of the way down.
lines.caption: Eighteen is what you'd get if G were three quarters of the way down.

lines.text: Twenty would need G to sit five parts out of six of the way down. That's much too close to B C.
lines.caption: Twenty would need G to sit five parts out of six of the way down. That's much too close to B C.

lines.text: So here's a great habit. Mark G two thirds of the way down a median, from the corner.
lines.caption: So here's a great habit. Mark G two thirds of the way down a median, from the corner.

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? Here's a new triangle.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? Here's a new triangle.

lines.text: The segment joining the middles of A B and A C is twenty-one long.
lines.caption: The segment joining the middles of A B and A C is twenty-one long.

lines.text: Again, E F runs through G, parallel to B C. How long is E F?
lines.caption: Again, E F runs through G, parallel to B C. How long is E F?

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. That middle segment is a half-size copy of B C. So B C is twice twenty-one, forty-two.
lines.caption: Let's check. That middle segment is a half-size copy of B C. So B C is twice twenty-one, forty-two.

lines.text: G is two thirds of the way down, so E F is two thirds of B C.
lines.caption: G is two thirds of the way down, so E F is two thirds of B C.

lines.text: Two thirds of forty-two is twenty-eight. <short pause> E F is twenty-eight!
lines.caption: Two thirds of forty-two is twenty-eight. E F is twenty-eight!

lines.text: If you found twenty-eight, amazing work!
lines.caption: If you found twenty-eight, amazing work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea to remember.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea to remember.

lines.text: The medians of a triangle meet two thirds of the way down each one, from its corner.
lines.caption: The medians of a triangle meet two thirds of the way down each one, from its corner.

lines.text: So a segment through that point, parallel to a side, is two thirds of that side.
lines.caption: So a segment through that point, parallel to a side, is two thirds of that side.

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
